changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Marketing proposal from comparable campaign evidence to a bounded, owner-reviewed growth experiment.

title: Campaign Signal to Reviewed Experiment
description: Explain a campaign conversion change from matched spend and CRM evidence, then prepare one bounded experiment plan with an optional sourced competitor context.
setup_prompt: Use Campaign Signal to Reviewed Experiment as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Marketing Crews, exact campaign/account/offer IDs, platform and downstream conversion sources, attribution and baseline definitions, owner, and experiment authority. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, validator steps, one manual campaign readout, an optional competitor context, and a proposed experiment with a predeclared decision rule. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not change spend, publish a variant, send a message, activate a flag, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Campaign, account, offer, market, period, time zone and currency
Qualified-event definition, identity join, attribution window and data-lag policy
Comparable baseline and current spend, click and CRM sources or exports
Decision owner, eligible audience, primary and guardrail metrics, change authority
Optional bounded competitor set and current dated source scope

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing Marketing Crews with stable idempotency keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass validated bounded campaign and optional competitor artifacts

recommended_tools.name: Ad or email platform or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read current and baseline delivery, clicks and spend

recommended_tools.name: CRM or analytics source or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read deduplicated qualified events for the same periods

recommended_tools.name: Approved public vendor source
recommended_tools.purpose: Read dated primary pages for optional context

recommended_tools.name: Experiment or campaign destination
recommended_tools.purpose: Apply only a separately approved exact change with provider receipt

pulse_focus.label: Campaign evidence to experiment decision
focus_areas: Whether qualified results changed under comparable definitions
Whether the proposed experiment has a predeclared success and guardrail rule
review_when: A campaign period closes, attribution finishes, an experiment decision is due, or a guardrail is breached

outputs: Reviewed Marketing Crew roster, campaign source map and metric policy
Validated campaign-performance-brief/v1 with current and baseline numerators and denominators
Optional dated competitor-context/v1 kept separate from measurement
Validated growth-experiment-plan/v1 with owner, test and stop rule
Manual route evidence, action ledger and activation choice
